diagnosis: Customer is on unified auth and needs to know the token reset procedure. KB-0003 describes scoped key rotation. No legacy migration or other issues indicated.
reply: For accounts on the unified auth setup, API credentials are managed as scoped keys. The recommended procedure is: 1) create a new scoped key, 2) update your integrations to use it, 3) once you confirm traffic is working, revoke the previous key. Please be aware that revocation is immediate and keys cannot be widened after creation. You can find the detailed steps in our guide on scoped API keys (kb-0003).
